raw_rows: Proceeds to Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (Before Expenses)

structured_note_terms.issue_date: June 30, 2025 (2 Business Days after the Pricing Date)
structured_note_terms.maturity_date: June 30, 2045 subject to our redemption right.
structured_note_terms.principal_amount: $6,777,000. We may increase the Aggregate Principal Amount prior to the Original Issue Date but are not required to do so.

additional_terms.Title of the Notes: Senior Fixed Rate 20 Year Callable Notes due June 30, 2045
additional_terms.Interest Rate: 6.50%, from and including the Original Issue Date to, but excluding, June 30, 2045.
additional_terms.Interest Payment Period:
Semi-annual (from and including the last calendar day of each June and December to, but excluding, the last calendar day of the month occurring six months following
such month, beginning June 30, 2025)
additional_terms.Interest Payment Dates: The last calendar day of each June and December beginning December 31, 2025.
additional_terms.Redemption:
We will have the right to redeem the Notes, in whole or in part on each Optional Redemption Date and pay to you 100% of the stated principal amount per Note plus
accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, such Optional Redemption Date. If we elect to redeem the Notes, we will give you notice at least 5 Business Days before the date of such redemption.
additional_terms.Optional Redemption Dates: The last calendar day of each June and December, beginning June 30, 2028 and ending December 31, 2044.
additional_terms.Business Day:
New York. If any Interest Payment Date, any Optional Redemption Date or the Maturity Date occurs on a day that is not a Business Day, any payment owed on such date will
be postponed as described in “The Notes” below.
additional_terms.Agent: Jefferies LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Jefferies Financial Group Inc. See “Supplemental Plan of Distribution.”
additional_terms.Trustee: The Bank of New York Mellon
additional_terms.Conflict of Interest:
Jefferies LLC, the broker-dealer subsidiary of Jefferies Financial Group Inc., is a member of FINRA and will participate in the distribution of the notes being offered
hereby. Accordingly, the offering is subject to the provisions of FINRA Rule 5121 relating to conflicts of interest and will be conducted in accordance with the requirements of Rule 5121. See “Conflict of Interest.”
